summary.text: Shannon Francis is a Republican state representative from Liberal who has represented District 125 since January 2015 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He chairs the House Transportation Committee and the Legislative Post Audit Committee.

paragraphs.text: Shannon Francis was born and lives in Liberal, Kansas.

He earned a bachelor's degree in business administration, with a focus on marketing and finance, from Kansas State University, and an associate degree from Seward County Community College and Area Technical School.
His professional experience includes serving as president of the Village at the Plaza and as managing partner of Evans Francis Farms Limited Liability Company.

Francis has also served as president of the Kansas Association of Counties, chair of the Seward County Community College Development Foundation's scholarship drive, and as a member of the Liberal Rotary Club and the Noon Lions Club.
Francis was elected to the Kansas House in 2014 and took office on January 12, 2015.
For 2025 and 2026 he sits on the Appropriations, Rules and Journal, and Taxation committees, and chairs the House Transportation Committee and the Legislative Post Audit Committee.
